entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. It's... well, it's just not working. I'm so confused by this thing.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, and the email is s.jenkins@email.com.

Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling up your account now... I see your recent purchase of the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Oh, a fault, I think. I'm not really sure. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. I've been trying for weeks. I think the band might just be broken or defective. I'm not very good with this stuff... Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help. I understand it can be frustrating when a new device isn't cooperating. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item for you. One moment please.
Alright, Sarah, I see here that the item was delivered to you 33 days ago. And you're saying it seems to be defective, correct?
Yes, that's right. It never seemed to work properly.

No problem at all. Our policy allows for returns on any item within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh! Really? That's it? I was so worried it was going to be complicated. That's wonderful, thank you so much, Alex.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. You've made this so easy. Thank you again for your help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day!
You too, Sarah. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
